INNER JOIN [AuctionM_dbuser].[tblAuctionStatuses] AS [t1] ON [t].[StatusId] = [t1].[StatusId]

    SELECT [t2].[AuctionAssetId], [t2].[AssetId], [t2].[AuctionId], [t3].[AssetId] AS [AssetId0], [t3].[AdminFees], [t3].[AssetNumber], [t3].[AuctionFees], [t3].[AwardingId], [t3].[BuyerCommission], [t3].[CategoryId], [t3].[Commission], [t3].[CourtCaseNumber], [t3].[CreatedAt], [t3].[Deposit], [t3].[Description], [t3].[Featured], [t3].[IncrementalTime], [t3].[IsAvailableForDirectSale], [t3].[IsDeleted], [t3].[MakeOffer], [t3].[MapLatitude], [t3].[MapLongitude], [t3].[MinIncrement], [t3].[RegistrationDeadline], [t3].[RequestForInquiry], [t3].[RequestForViewing], [t3].[ReserveAmount], [t3].[SalesNotes], [t3].[SellerId], [t3].[StartingPrice], [t3].[StatusId], [t3].[Title], [t3].[UpdatedAt], [t3].[VATId], [t3].[VATPercent], [t3].[WinnerId]
    FROM [AuctionM_dbuser].[tblAuctionAssets] AS [t2]
    INNER JOIN [AuctionM_dbuser].[tblAssets] AS [t3] ON [t2].[AssetId] = [t3].[AssetId]
) AS [s] ON [t].[AuctionId] = [s].[AuctionId]
WHERE [t].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit)
ORDER BY [t].[AuctionId], [t0].[CategoryId], [t1].[StatusId], [s].[AuctionAssetId]

    SELECT [t0].[PaymentOptionId], [t0].[CategoryId], [t0].[PaymentMethodId], [t1].[Id], [t1].[Name]
    FROM [AuctionM_dbuser].[TblAssetCategoryPaymentMethod] AS [t0]
    INNER JOIN [AuctionM_dbuser].[TblAssetPaymentMethod] AS [t1] ON [t0].[PaymentMethodId] = [t1].[Id]
) AS [s] ON [t].[CategoryId] = [s].[CategoryId]
WHERE [t].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit)
ORDER BY [t].[CategoryId], [s].[PaymentOptionId]
